One of the best-known names in home networking solutions, Netgear, has a variety of Black Friday deals available across its range of devices. You can find discounts of up to $400 on complete home mesh network solutions, and up to 15% off the list price of home gaming routers from the Nighthawk line-up.

Black Friday Netgear Orbi Mesh Network Deals

These home network mesh solutions come with a router and two satellite WiFi extenders. You can choose between Quad-Band, Tri-Band, and Dual-Band units depending on your connectivity needs and budget.

Orbi 970 Series (3-pack): was $1999.99 now $1599.99
This elite Quad-Band mesh solution supports Wi-Fi 7 with speeds up to 27Gbps. This is the black edition 3-pack, which consists of 1x router and 2x satellites. Offers up to 10,000 sq. ft. of coverage. View Deal

Orbi 770 Series: was $699.99 now $568.99
A WiFi 7 mesh system that offers up to 8,000 sq. ft. of wireless coverage. This is the 3-pack with 1x router and 2x satellites. Speeds of up to 11 Gbps on Tri-Band, supporting 100 Devices. View Deal

Orbi 370 Series: was $349.99 now $274.99
The Dual-Band version of the Orbi, with a triple pack consisting of a main router and two satellites. Get coverage up to 6,000 sq. ft. and WiFi 7 speeds up to 5 Gbps. View Deal

Black Friday Nighthawk Gaming Router Deals

Grab a great deal on an upgrade for your gaming network. Never use lag as an excuse again with these gaming focused Netgear Nighthawk routers. Fast bandwidth speeds and WiFi 7 connectivity have you covered for all your online gaming needs.

Nighthawk RS600 WiFi 7 Router: was $499.99 now $449.99
Installing the RS600 will get you up to 18 Gbps tri-band WiFi 7 speeds, and with a host of 10 Gbps ports for multi-gig wired performance on the rear, you can host a blisteringly fast home network for gaming. View Deal

Nighthawk RS300 WiFi 7 Router: was $299.99 now $269.99
The Nighthawk RS300 boasts speeds up to 9.3 Gbps on its tri-band WiFi 7 connection and can cover an area in your home of around 2,500 sq. ft. View Deal

Nighthawk RS100 WiFi 7 Router: was $149.99 now $127.48
The RS100 Nighthawk from Netgear supports up to 3.6Gbps speeds via its dual-band WiFi 7 connection. It can host up to 50 devices and cover an area of up to 2,000 sq. ft. There is 1x 2.5G port and 3x 1G ports on the rear. View Deal

Black Friday Netgear WiFi Extender deal

An awesome discount on a great solution for gaining a little more wireless coverage in your home. This plug and play WiFi extender will get rid of any wireless darkspots in your home by boosting the range of your WiFi signal.

Nighthawk WiFi Extender EAX17: was $129.99 now $87.29
Simply plug and play to gain up to 1,500 sq ft of extra WiFi coverage in your home. Supports speeds up to 3 Gbps and up to 20 devices. Works with any router and also sports a 1G Ethernet port for hardwiring a connection to the extender. WiFi 6. View Deal
